instruction: I need to set the maximum volume limit in VLC to 150. The current maximum of 125 is sometimes not enough for quiet audio, but 200 is too loud for my speakers.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the maximum volume in VLC to 150. Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric function to verify the qt-max-volume setting is set to 150 in the VLC configuration file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (get_vlc_config) extracts the VLC configuration file from the correct platform-specific path
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses the config file and checks the qt-max-volume setting
Expected value '150' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure fresh config state
Metric function correctly handles rule parameter - accesses rule['expected_qt_max_volume'] directly (not rule.get('rules', {}))
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting max volume to 150, evaluator verifies qt-max-volume equals 150
Default value handling is appropriate (125 is the VLC default)
